_doc.purpose: Localization companion for COM_daily.json. Holds en-us entries for the topic-based talk interaction variants. Tense/style matched to the already-translated non-topic siblings (com_interaction_talk_begin_1/2/3, displayName_2) in the same file.

en-us.com_interaction_talk_begin_1_topic: $doer.firstname$ started chatting with $receiver.firstname$ about $topic$ without much focus
en-us.com_interaction_goto_schedule: Player only. Travel to where your schedule for the current hour takes place.
en-us.com_interaction_goto_schedule_noSchedule: Nowhere to go for the current hour
en-us.com_interaction_goto_schedule_busy: $name$ is busy with something that cannot be interrupted
en-us.com_interaction_work: Player only. For your current work shift: go to a room with work equipment, or carry out one work command in the current room.
en-us.com_interaction_work_noShift: No work shift for the current hour
en-us.com_interaction_work_noCommand: This post has no work command - being on site is enough
